summary: persona-ai-sdk ships obfuscated import-time loader disguised as build-cache manifests
details: The package's declared main (index.mjs) re-exports personas.mjs, which at module top level imports cssVarMap from./cache-warm.mjs and invokes it in an 8-iteration loop over a hardcoded ID list. cache-warm.mjs is a ~280 KB single-line obfuscator.io-style string-array module whose decoded body references child_process, spawn, exec, net, eval, and dynamic import, while its header comment falsely identifies it as an 'auto-generated build cache manifest' for persona-ai-sdk@1.0.0. Three sibling files shipped at the tarball root (build-cache.mjs ~203 KB, cache-sweep.mjs ~281 KB, workspaces.js ~289 KB) use the same cover-story header, the same obfuscation shape with hex-named identifiers, and the same set of dangerous APIs (child_process/spawn/exec/net/eval). Legitimate build caches do not contain process-spawning or network primitives. Any consumer that imports persona-ai-sdk executes the obfuscated loader at require/import time with no user action beyond installation and import.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
